quests.title: Graffiti Different Areas
quests.description: Use sidewalk chalk to create art in public spaces. Know the rules first!

quests.title: Paint a Rock
quests.description: Find a rock, paint it, leave it somewhere for someone to find.

quests.title: Random Library Book Roulette
quests.description: Close your eyes, pick a random book, read it.

quests.title: Photography Scavenger Hunt
quests.description: Hunt for cool doors, patterns, pigeons, graffiti, doorknobs, architectural objects.

quests.title: Climb a Tree
quests.description: Find a climbable tree, embrace your inner kid.

quests.title: Blind Food Roulette
quests.description: Close your eyes, pick a point on a map, go to the closest restaurant and try food.

quests.title: Celebrate Your Happy Birthday
quests.description: Make today your birthday. Celebrate it fully.

quests.title: Random Food Tasting Challenge
quests.description: Hit three nearby stalls. Pick one thing you've never tried at each. Budget: ₹100 total.

quests.title: Make 3 Reels
quests.description: Create three short videos. Any vibe, any topic.

quests.title: Fashion Show in Your Room
quests.description: Model your own clothes like you're on a runway.

quests.title: Recreate a Childhood Photo
quests.description: Find an old photo of yourself and recreate it as accurately as possible.

quests.title: Make a Newspaper About Your Life
quests.description: One page: breaking news, weather, sports, scandals, celebrity gossip about friends.

quests.title: Random Outfit Generator
quests.description: Number your clothes, use a random number generator, wear the combo it gives you.

quests.title: Mannequin Photo Challenge
quests.description: Find a mannequin, wear the same clothes, recreate its exact pose.

quests.title: Make Your Flag
quests.description: Design and create your personal flag. Be as creative as you want.

quests.title: Cloud Casting
quests.description: Lie down somewhere and give names to 10 clouds.

quests.title: Make a Music Video
quests.description: Create a music video to a song you love.

quests.title: Humans of My House Series
quests.description: Interview roommates with 3 weird questions each. Write/record it.

quests.title: Free Call an Astrologer
quests.description: Use free astrology apps or numbers. Ask them wild questions.

quests.title: Free Call a Matchmaker
quests.description: Try finding your perfect match or your friend's. See what happens.

quests.title: Make & Bury a Time Capsule
quests.description: Create a time capsule and bury it somewhere you'll remember.

quests.title: Play Like a Child in a Park
quests.description: Hide-and-seek, tag, hopscotch, frisbee. Anything you haven't done in years.

quests.title: Karaoke in Your Room
quests.description: Use YouTube or Apple Music. Belt it out in your dorm.

quests.title: Crash a Random Wedding
quests.description: Find a wedding happening. Dance, eat, leave without being caught.

quests.title: Create Your Iconic Handshake
quests.description: Come up with a unique handshake. Teach it to friends.

quests.title: Movie Hall Hall-Hopping
quests.description: Watch a movie, at interval switch to another hall and watch the 2nd half of a different movie.

quests.title: Make a 'What's in My Bag' Video
quests.description: Film yourself explaining everything in your bag. Post it or share it.

quests.title: Build a Blanket Fort
quests.description: Create an elaborate fort in your room using bedsheets and blankets.

quests.title: Go Fruit Shopping (Analog Way)
quests.description: Forget Blinkit. Go to a real fruit market, pick fresh stuff.

quests.title: Room Cardio Rave
quests.description: Full cardio workout in your room with bangers. Just you and the music.
